solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Spread in breadth, say

definitions.meaning: reads as a width or extent, but is a soft food put on toast
the word breadth starts with bread, and bread is exactly where this spread goes

explanation.surface: Something that extends across a wide area, as though measuring a field.
explanation.walkthrough: Spread looks like a verb about width; the joke is that breadth begins with bread, the thing butter is spread on.
explanation.definitionFit: Butter is the dairy spread most commonly smeared on slices of bread.

clue.text: Occasion for celebration, often involving light blow-out?

definitions.meaning: a light blow-out sounds like a modest feast, but means blowing out the lit candles on a cake

explanation.surface: A party where the food is fairly modest.
explanation.walkthrough: A blow-out is slang for a big meal, so a light blow-out sounds like a small spread; really the lights being blown out are cake candles.
explanation.definitionFit: The yearly anniversary of being born is celebrated with a cake whose candles are blown out.

clue.text: No-win situations besetting mass publication

indicators.note: to beset is to surround, so the draws wrap around the letter for mass

parts.note: matches that end level, with nobody winning, are draws

explanation.surface: Deadlocks that plague a mass-market newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: The Times is a well-known British newspaper, a daily publication.

clue.text: Stimulate new learner I put in uniform

indicators.note: these three short pieces are placed inside the word for uniform

parts.note: something uniform is level or even throughout
taken as written

explanation.surface: Motivating a novice by dressing them in a uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: Uniform looks like clothing to put someone in, but it is the adjective meaning level.
explanation.definitionFit: To enliven is to make livelier, to animate or stimulate.

clue.text: Mighty hunter's sleeping quarters at home turned over

indicators.note: flipped end to end, so the bedroom word and the home word are read backwards together

parts.note: a dormitory, shortened
someone at home is in

explanation.surface: Where a great hunter sleeps when back at the house, upturned.
explanation.walkthrough: Nimrod is the mighty hunter of the Book of Genesis; the name is also one of Elgar's Enigma Variations, tying in with 10/12.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical Nimrod is described as a mighty hunter, and his name now means any skilled huntsman.

clue.text: Rough occupying court, holding chopper up

indicators.note: the pair of pieces wraps around the tool

parts.note: something occupying a space is in it

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the tool's name is written bottom to top

parts.note: an axe chops

explanation.surface: A ruffian takes over a courtyard while raising an axe.
explanation.walkthrough: Rough reads as a noun for a thug, but it is the adjective meaning approximate.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough estimate is approximate, not precise.

clue.text: Some terrain, in essence, is what produces flooding

indicators.note: only part of the words is used, the run of letters sitting inside them

parts.note: the letters run unbroken across the end of terrain, all of in, and the start of essence

explanation.surface: A philosophical claim that the true nature of land is what causes floods.
explanation.definitionFit: Wet, rainy weather is the cause of floods, so rainy conditions produce flooding.

clue.text: Set piece generally spotted in each half

definitions.meaning: sounds like a rehearsed play in sport, but means one tile from a boxed set
sounds like a player seen in both halves of a match, but describes the pips on each end of the tile

explanation.surface: A football set-piece that keeps being noticed in both halves of a game.
explanation.walkthrough: Set piece and half both suggest football; the object is a game tile with dots on each of its two ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Each tile in a game of dominoes is divided in two, with a number of dots on each half.

clue.text: Complaints as doctor breaks key laws

parts.note: G is a musical key

indicators.note: the doctor breaks into the laws, sitting inside them

parts.note: rules
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: Grievances because a physician violates important regulations.
explanation.walkthrough: Key looks like an adjective meaning important; it is a musical key, G.
explanation.definitionFit: Grumbles are minor gripes or complaints.

clue.text: Page with line inserted in necessary rewrite for scripts

indicators.note: the page and line letters go inside the rearranged word
a rewrite reorders the letters of the word necessary

parts.note: the word itself supplies the letters to be reordered

explanation.surface: A writer adds a page with an extra line in a needed redraft of film scripts.
explanation.definitionFit: A screenplay is the written script of a film.

clue.text: Pieces by 21 Down, such as 4 — and 22?

definitions.meaning: musical pieces by the composer at 21 Down, one of which is named for the entry at 4
the entry at 22 is a rearrangement of the first word, so it is literally a variation of it

explanation.surface: A cross-reference asking for a composer's works, of which two grid answers are examples.
explanation.walkthrough: Elgar's Enigma Variations include Nimrod; Gamine is not one, but its letters rearrange the word enigma, a joke variation.
explanation.definitionFit: Elgar's orchestral work of 1899 is a set of fourteen variations on an original theme.

clue.text: In this way, most of the states united

indicators.note: all but the final letter of the word is kept

parts.note: taken as written, then trimmed
the United States, written in reverse word order

explanation.surface: A statement that this is how the American states were joined.
explanation.definitionFit: Thus is an adverb meaning in this manner or so.

clue.text: See 10
After terrible danger, recent changes that can help people grow a lot

definitions.text: that can help people grow a lot

indicators.note: the word danger is mangled into another word

parts.note: the word itself supplies the letters for the first word

indicators.note: the word recent is rearranged into another word

parts.note: the word itself supplies the letters for the second word

explanation.surface: After a dreadful threat, recent reforms that help many people develop.
explanation.walkthrough: A lot sounds like a great deal; it is a plot of land, as in an allotment.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden centre is a shop selling plants and tools for gardeners to cultivate their plot.

clue.text: Ordering starter for dinner in Greece, curiously

indicators.note: the first letter of the word, as a starter opens a meal

parts.note: its opening letter is the one taken

indicators.note: the letters are put in an odd new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A diner choosing a first course while in Greece, in an odd way.
explanation.walkthrough: Ordering and starter suggest a restaurant; ordering is really commanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Decreeing is issuing an official command, i.e. ordering.

clue.text: Having left, is about to catch up, one hears

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in a down clue the about and catch words are written bottom to top

parts.note: re means concerning
to net something is to catch it

explanation.surface: Someone who departed is about to catch up with the others.
explanation.walkthrough: Catch up looks like a phrasal verb, but up is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A listener is a person who hears, as of a radio broadcast.

clue.text: Miles covered by fellow, one sailing in competition

indicators.note: the fellow wraps around the abbreviation for miles

parts.note: a chap is a man
someone sailing is aboard, on ship

explanation.surface: A man named Miles is shadowed by another as one boat sails in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: Miles looks like a man's name; it is the plural unit, abbreviated M.
explanation.definitionFit: A championship is a contest held to decide a title holder.

clue.text: In part of jail men threatened disorder

indicators.note: the letters are found in a portion of the following words

parts.note: the letters run from inside jail through men into the start of threatened

explanation.surface: In one wing of a prison, inmates threatened a riot.
explanation.walkthrough: Disorder suggests rioting; it means a medical complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: An ailment is an illness, a disorder of the body.

clue.text: Too old to have romance and passion? Not 50, for a start

indicators.note: the Roman numeral for fifty is dropped from the romance word
the letter dropped is the opening one

parts.note: love
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
rage, a violent passion

explanation.surface: Being past it for love affairs and intensity, unless you are under fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: Over-age means older than the permitted limit.

clue.text: Vehement outburst when one's caught in traffic

indicators.note: the numeral one is trapped inside the commerce word

parts.note: traffic as dealing or commerce, trade

explanation.surface: Road rage when someone is stuck in a jam.
explanation.walkthrough: Traffic suggests cars; here it means trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirade is an angry, long denunciation, a furious outburst.

clue.text: In maturity, getting podgier with ale, perhaps?

indicators.note: signals the letters could be some other arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Getting plumper with age, maybe from beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Reaching a ripe old age means living to be elderly, an advanced stage of life.

clue.text: Scoffs, out of spite at someone

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the run of words

parts.note: the letters run from the end of spite through at into the start of someone

explanation.surface: Mocks someone in spite.
explanation.walkthrough: Scoffs looks like jeers; in British slang to scoff is to eat greedily.
explanation.definitionFit: Eats in the sense of wolfs down food, a sense of scoffs.

clue.text: Composer turning fifty in years, right?

indicators.note: the combined years-and-fifty piece is turned round
the numeral for fifty sits inside the years word

parts.note: an age is a long period of years

explanation.surface: A musician turning fifty years old asks if that is correct.
explanation.walkthrough: Turning fifty reads as reaching a birthday; turning is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar was the English composer of the Enigma Variations.

clue.text: Mischievous young woman finally detonating an explosive device

indicators.note: the last letter of the word that follows

parts.note: its final letter is the one taken
the indefinite article, written as A
a buried bomb

explanation.surface: A naughty girl at last sets off a bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamine is an elfin, impish girl.

clue.text: Awful nag in cast attacking abusively

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go inside the throwing word

parts.note: to sling is to throw

indicators.note: something awful is a terrible mess, so the letters of nag come out scrambled

parts.note: the word itself supplies the letters to be jumbled

explanation.surface: A horrid old horse in a cast lashing out.
explanation.walkthrough: Nag and cast suggest a lame horse in plaster; cast is the verb throw.
explanation.definitionFit: A slanging match is an exchange of insults, so slanging means verbally abusing.

clue.text: Score under 100 — that's significant when opener's dropped

indicators.note: the first letter of the significant word is removed

parts.note: important, weighty

explanation.surface: A cricket score below a century matters when the opening batsman is out.
explanation.walkthrough: A score is twenty, so four score is a number under a hundred; the cricket picture is a decoy.
explanation.definitionFit: Eighty is four score, a number below a hundred.

clue.text: Alarm time set by mistake

parts.note: an error

explanation.surface: A clock alarm set for the wrong hour.
explanation.walkthrough: Alarm suggests a clock; it means fear.
explanation.definitionFit: Terror is extreme fear or alarm.
